name: tish-shadertoy
description: Run Shadertoy GLSL shaders in a native OpenGL window, driven from Tish

scripts.build: npm run build:blocking && npm run build:pumped
scripts.start: [ -x target/pumped ] || npm run build:pumped; target/pumped shaders/
scripts.lint: tish-lint examples && tish-format --check examples/blocking/main.tish && tish-format --check examples/pumped/main.tish
